add_block.new_heading: The JBR catering menu and cuisine options
new_paragraphs: The JBR catering menu is fully bespoke — you pick the cuisine and the chef builds the courses around it. Popular choices span Arabic , Mediterranean , Italian , Indian and Pan-Asian, all cooked fresh in your kitchen. Every menu can be halal , and we cater vegetarian and vegan tables without making them an afterthought. Gluten-free options are available on request, subject to partner confirmation and an allergen review for the specific booking. For a beachfront setting, guests often ask for seafood grills, mezze grazing boards and lighter shared plates; for a celebration dinner, a plated three- or four-course tasting suits better. Browse sample menus for ideas or describe a theme — a Levantine feast, a pasta-forward Italian evening, a mixed grill — and we shape it to your guest count and budget. Nothing comes off a fixed list; the jbr catering services menu is written for your evening.

add_block.new_heading: Beachfront logistics: access, kitchens and timing
new_paragraphs: JBR's beachfront towers shape how we plan, so we sort access and timing before the chef arrives. Jumeirah Beach Residence apartments have compact kitchens and shared loading points, so we schedule equipment drop-off around building service lifts and confirm parking or valet access on The Walk in advance. For beach BBQs and grazing we plan around beach access and any building rules on open flame; for tower dining we work cleanly within an apartment galley kitchen, bringing our own portable equipment where needed. Sunset timing matters here — many hosts want canapés served as the light drops, so the chef paces the courses to the view. We also coordinate with concierge and security for guest entry. None of this lands on you: once your date and address are confirmed, the logistics are ours to manage, and the day runs to a schedule you have already approved.

add_block.new_heading: How much does a private chef cost in JBR?
new_paragraphs: A private chef in JBR costs from AED 700 per person, and the exact jbr private chef cost depends on guest count, menu and service level. Pricing is per head and comes down as numbers rise: intimate dinners for two sit nearer AED 950–1,300 per person, around six guests roughly AED 750–1,000, and ten or more from AED 700. Multi-course tasting menus and premium ingredients — think fresh seafood, prime cuts or a dessert course — sit at the upper end; relaxed grazing and BBQ formats at the lower. There are no hidden extras: your itemised proposal lists the menu, the chef, service staff and setup so you can see where every dirham goes. For a full breakdown by format and group size, see private chef prices in Dubai , or send your numbers for an exact quote.

new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in JBR?
Private dining in JBR starts from about AED 700–950 per person, depending on guest count, menu and service level. Larger groups come down per head; send your numbers for an exact quote.
Which parts of JBR do you serve?
All of JBR — Jumeirah Beach Residence towers, beachfront apartments along The Walk and the surrounding streets — plus nearby Dubai communities. Confirm your exact address when you enquire.
What's included?
Everything: from menu planning to the chef, the service staff, the plating and the cleanup — one team covers all of it, cooked live in your kitchen.
How do I book?
Share your date, guest count and address; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
Can you cater a dinner party or private event in JBR?

Yes — a private chef JBR booking covers jbr dinner party catering for a table of eight to twelve, larger jbr event catering across an apartment, and canapé receptions. Tell us the occasion and the chef designs the menu around it.
Do you offer in-villa and villa chef service in JBR?
Yes — in-villa chef jbr service and jbr villa catering are available for the larger beachfront residences, alongside apartment dining in the towers, all cooked fresh in your own kitchen.
Is halal and dietary-friendly catering available in JBR?

Yes. Every menu can be halal, and we cater vegetarian and vegan tables. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
For private chef jbr, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
